_note: Jobs mirror composer.json's scripts. This repository has no Pint, Rector, PHPStan or Pest, so those template jobs are absent rather than stubbed.

guard._note: uams-sentinel-config.php is named because this estate's copies carry per-site baseline signing keys and a Teams webhook URL, and the file is a plain list of define() calls that reads like ordinary source. Site lists are gitignored; the guard is the backstop for a --force.

jobs.name: phpcs
jobs._note: phpcs.xml.dist scopes this to the one shipped file, so the plugin and its config are the only inputs.

jobs.name: phpunit
jobs._note: Needs the WordPress test library, which install-wp-tests.sh puts under the system temp directory and macOS clears periodically. A failure here that names a missing bootstrap is that, not a regression; re-run bin/install-wp-tests.sh. It cannot be a requires entry, because the path is outside the repository.

jobs.name: phpunit-killswitch
jobs._note: FR5 decides at include time and a PHP constant cannot be undefined, so the kill switch needs its own process and its own config.

jobs.name: acceptance-syntax
jobs._note: bin/acceptance.sh runs against live sites and is never executed by CI. This only proves it parses.
